test.name: Fuzz nats_readiness_protocol, then rerun provider_manifest and provider_interpolation, 10 minutes each

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runs nats_readiness_protocol, then provider_manifest and provider_interpolation, for 600 seconds each, one at a time, with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz, and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory in any target and fuzz/artifacts/ empty; nats_readiness_protocol: 4369977 runs in 601 s (7271 exec/s), 12538 new units, peak RSS 590 MB; provider_manifest: 958658 runs in 601 s (1595 exec/s), 9459 new units, peak RSS 462 MB; provider_interpolation: 1821178 runs in 601 s (3030 exec/s), 3878 new units, peak RSS 664 MB
steps: on commit 63d7a54 (spec 0023 step 4: the nats_readiness_protocol harness, target, TARGETS row, and seeds, on top of main with spec 0017 step 1 and spec 0019 steps 1 and 2) with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2; `cargo xtask fuzz build nats_readiness_protocol` builds the target with AddressSanitizer (default)

start from the committed seeds only (fuzz/corpus empty in this worktree): nats_readiness_protocol 11 (7 transcripts recorded from nats-server 2.15.1 in the step 0 spike and 4 synthetic ones), provider_manifest 4, provider_interpolation 32

run `/usr/bin/time cargo xtask fuzz run <target> --time 600` for nats_readiness_protocol, provider_manifest, and provider_interpolation one at a time, because the Mac is shared by other sessions; the runs went from 2026-10-20T01:34:32Z to 02:04:43Z
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input for any target, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the head and tail of each log in this record's files folder (the middle NEW, REDUCE, and pulse progress lines are cut)
